keywords = [
    KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FIRST_STRIKE),
    KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.HEXPROOF, params=(FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.COLOR_HAS, color='W'),)),
]
abilities = [
    # [0] This creature gets +1/+0 as long as any player controls a white permanent.
    StaticAbility(
        effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
            'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
            'target': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=0)),
        }),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QConst(value=1),
            quantity=QCount(
                selector=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.COLOR_HAS, color='W'),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    # [1] (cast)
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),
]
